raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices for fintech. Seeking the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with expertise in system design, code review, and distributed systems architecture.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints.
Implemented JPA/Hibernate repositories and MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn Python or JavaScript to match the JD's language requirements; your Java foundation will transfer quickly.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Pub/Sub to strengthen your candidacy for a Google Cloud role.
Deepen your system design knowledge by studying distributed systems patterns (consensus, replication, sharding) and documenting your microservices architecture decisions in design reviews.
raw_resume.growth_note: You have strong Java and microservices experience, but the JD emphasises multiple programming languages (Python, JavaScript, C++) and GCP expertise, neither of which your profile currently shows. Gaining proficiency in at least one additional language and GCP will significantly improve your fit.
